title: A Distribution Regression Approach to Censored Selection Models
abstract: arXiv:2505.10814v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We develop a distribution regression model with a censored selection rule, offering a semi-parametric generalization of the Heckman selection model. Our approach applies to the entire distribution, extending beyond the mean or median, accommodates non-Gaussian error structures, and allows for heterogeneous effects of covariates on both the selection and outcome distributions. By employing a censored selection rule, our model can uncover richer selection patterns according to both outcome and selection variables, compared to the binary selection case. We analyze identification, estimation, and inference of model functionals such as sorting parameters and distributions purged of sample selection. An application to labor supply using data from the UK reveals different selection patterns into full-time and overtime work across gender, marital status, and time. translated_title: 一种针对删失选择模型的分布回归方法
translated_abstract: arXiv:2505.10814v2 公告类型：替换 摘要：我们开发了一种带有删失选择规则的分布回归模型，提供了Heckman选择模型的半参数推广。我们的方法适用于整个分布，超越了均值或中位数，能够适应非高斯误差结构，并允许协变量对选择分布和结果分布产生异质性影响。通过采用删失选择规则，与二元选择情况相比，我们的模型能够根据结果变量和选择变量揭示更丰富的选择模式。我们分析了模型泛函（如排序参数和去除样本选择后的分布）的识别、估计和推断。利用英国数据的劳动供给应用揭示了不同性别、婚姻状况和时间下全职与加班工作的不同选择模式。此外，按性别分解工资分布显示，选择效应在解释性别工资差异中起重要作用。
tldr: 本文提出了一种半参数分布回归模型，通过删失选择规则推广Heckman模型，能够全面分析分布层面的选择效应，并在英国劳动供给数据中揭示了性别和婚姻状况对工作选择及工资差异的复杂影响。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a semi-parametric distribution regression model with a censored selection rule, generalizing the Heckman model to capture distribution-level selection effects, and reveals complex gender and marital status impacts on work choices and wage gaps using UK labor data.
